parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions over 4×4 local grids for blue and red roles at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current estimates (represented times 12–13) are reported per panel: p0 current peaks — n0: blue at the top-left 2×2, red at the top-right 2×2; n1: blue top-right 2×2, red top-left 2×2; n2: blue at cell [0,1], red at [0,2]; n3: blue at [1,3], red at [0,0]. Panel p1 current peaks match those cells; p1 origins indicate completed records. Candidate conditional records (commands k0,k1,k2) present alternative distributions (not executed events). Notable differences include for node n1: k0 gives uniform peaks (all 16 cells) in p0/p1; k1 swaps quadrant preferences between roles; k2 places blue peak at [1,2] and red at [0,0]. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are conditional alternatives only.

parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0, p1). Row increases downward, column rightward. Origins in the data identify copied or completed prior records versus native conditional records; copied prior records are not new estimates, and conditional command records are conditional proposals, not events that have occurred. Current (non‑conditional) estimates: in both panels, n0’s blue peak is at cell [0,0] and red peak at [0,2]; n1 in current p0 and p1 has multi‑modal peaks on the 2×2 block {[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]} for both roles; n2’s current peaks are the four cells {[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]} for both roles; n3’s current blue peak is [1,3] and red peak is [0,0]. Conditional command records (k0,k1,k2) change some node estimates: for example at panel p0 node n1 blue shifts peak between [1,2] (k0,k1) and [0,0] (k2) with differing peak probabilities; in panel p1 node n1 k2 is a uniform peak set (all 16 cells) unlike other candidate records that concentrate on small sets. Treat all quoted peaks and reported uncertainties as distributional summaries only.

parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0, p1) of fallible location distributions for red and blue roles at four addressed nodes (n0–n3) on separate 4×4 grids (rows down, columns right). Panel entries labeled current are inherited or completed records for represented times shown; candidate entries (commands k0,k1,k2) are conditional estimates, not executed events. For panel p0 current: n0 peaks — blue at (0,0), red at (0,2); n1 peaks — blue and red across the 2×2 block (rows 0–1, cols 0–1); n2 peaks — both roles on the four cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3); n3 peaks — blue at (1,3), red at (0,0). Panel p1 current: n0 peaks — blue (0,0), red (0,2); n1 peaks — 2×2 block (0–1,0–1) for both roles; n2 peaks — same four-cell set as p0; n3 peaks — blue (1,3), red (0,0). Candidate records show alternative peak sets per command as listed in propositions; these are conditional estimates, not claims that those commands occurred.

parsed.text: Panels p0 and p1 each present fallible 4x4 location distributions for blue and red at nodes n0–n3. Current (view=current) summaries: n0 — blue peak at (0,0) (≈0.96), red peak at (0,2) (≈1.00). n1 — multimodal top-left peaks {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)} in current view for both roles. n2 — both roles peak on the upper-right block {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)}. n3 — blue peaks at (1,3), red peaks at (0,0). Candidate records (view=candidate, command=k0/k1/k2) are conditional estimates, not executed events; some entries are inherited/copied from prior records and are not new estimates. Conditional estimates differ by command at some nodes: for example node n1 under several candidate commands sometimes concentrates blue at (1,2) with high peak probability (k0/k1 in p0 and some k1 in p1), while other candidate records leave n1 multimodal or uniform (notably k2 in panel p1 is uniform). Treat all quoted probabilities and peaks as properties of the supplied distributions only.

Node n2’s distributions concentrate on the right-half cells [(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)] for both roles. Node n1’s current distributions place mass across the upper-left 2×2 cells [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)] for both roles. Conditional records differ: for example panel p0 node n1’s blue mass concentrates at (1,2) under k0 (peak ~0.92), k1 (~0.87) and k2 (~0.53), while red remains peaked at (0,0) in those conditionals; in panel p1 k2 for node n1 is uniform (all 16 cells peak-tied). Treat these values as distributional summaries only.

parsed.text: This packet gives fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current (view=current) estimates are: at n0 blue peaks at (0,2) and red at (0,0); at n1 blue at (1,0) and red at (0,2); n2 is uniform for both roles; n3 has blue concentrated on the top-left 2×2 and red on the top-right 2×2. Candidate command records (view=candidate) show alternative conditional distributions: k0 shifts p0 n0 blue to the top-right 2×2 and red to the top-left 2×2; k1 makes p0 n0 sharply blue at (0,2) and red at (0,0); k2 makes p0 n0 uniform. Panel p1 contains analogous current and conditional distributions. Origins in the packet indicate copied or completed prior records are inherited (not new estimates), and native conditional records are conditional branches (not executed events).

parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current-view distributions are marked view="current"; candidate command-conditioned distributions are view="candidate" with command k0,k1,k2. Origins and times supplied: copied or inherited prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are hypothetical branches, not executed events. Current estimates (panel p0 and p1) place strong single-cell peaks for many nodes (examples: p0 n1 blue peak at [1,2], red peak at [0,0]; p1 n1 blue peak at [1,2], red peak at [0,0]). Conditional candidates show differences in which cells have the largest probability and in peak probabilities (for example, p0 n1 blue peaks remain at [1,2] across candidates but the red peak probability at [0,0] varies substantially; p1 n1 includes a k0 uniform conditional and other candidates that concentrate probability on subsets). No physical presences or subjective states are inferred; the report describes only the supplied probability distributions and their peak locations.

Current (view=current) summaries: n0 — blue peaks at (0,0), red at (0,2); n1 — blue peaks at (1,2), red at (0,0); n2 — blue mass concentrated on the top-left 2×2 cells, red on the top-right 2×2 cells; n3 — blue on the top-right 2×2, red on the top-left 2×2. Node n0 and the complementary top-half patterns at n2/n3 are stable across most conditional records.

parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue roles on 4×4 local grids in panels p0 and p1. Copied or completed prior records indicated in origins are inherited, not new estimates; conditional command records (k0/k1/k2) are hypothetical branches, not executed events. Current (non‑conditional) summaries: in both panels, nodes n0 and n1 have narrow peaks — p0/p1 n0 blue at (0,3) and red at (0,1); n1 blue at (1,1) and red at (0,3). Panel p0 current n2 and n3 are multimodal: p0 current n2 blue peaks at (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red peaks at (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); p0 current n3 swaps those groupings. Panel p1 current n2 and n3 show the same multimodal peak groupings as p0 current n2/n3. Conditional command records change those multimodal patterns in several candidate branches: for example, p0 candidate k0 and k1 concentrate blue and red at single cells for node n2 (blue at (0,2) with higher peak probability in k1; red at (0,1) in those branches), while k2 yields coincident red and blue peaks at (0,1). Panel p1 candidates include both uniform (all 16 cells as peaks) and concentrated conditional forecasts for node n2 across different commands. No physical presence, event occurrence or calibrated confidence is asserted — the text reports only the supplied distribution peaks and the conditional vs current provenance.

Current-panel p0 and p1 estimates: n0 — blue concentrates at cell (0,3), red at (0,1). n1 — blue concentrates at (1,1), red at (0,3). n2 and n3 in both panels are multi-peaked: in the current p0 and p1 records blue peaks span cells in the top two rows of columns 2–3 while red peaks span complementary top-two-row column pairs (lists provided in propositions). Candidate (conditional) records k0,k1,k2 show alternative peak placements at particular nodes: for example at panel p0 node n2 candidates k0 and k1 place the blue peak at (0,2) and red at (0,1) with higher peak probabilities, while candidate k2 places blue and red peaks at (0,1). In panel p1 candidate k0 for node n2 is uniform (all 16 cells tied); other candidates concentrate peaks on small subsets as shown. Copied prior records and conditional command records are presented as inherited or conditional estimates, not as executed events.

parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4x4 location distributions for two panels (p0, p1), four addressed nodes (n0–n3) and two roles (red, blue). Copied prior records are labeled as inherited and are not new independent estimates; native conditional records and command-specific entries are conditional estimates, not events that have occurred. Current estimates (view=current) show, in both panels, strong single-cell peaks at n0 (blue at [0,3], red at [0,1]) and at n1 (blue at [1,1], red at [0,3]). At n2 and n3 current panels differ: n2 (p0 and p1) concentrates on a right-column pair cluster for blue and a left cluster for red; n3 shows a top-left 2x2 blue cluster and a top-right 2x2 red cluster. Candidate (commanded) records vary by command: some command entries leave n2 uniform, others concentrate probability differently (e.g., k1 gives a single-cell blue peak at [0,2] in some records; k2 shifts cluster assignments). Origins and represented times are provided per record; these are estimates only and do not assert physical facts.
